facts.material: not stated (metal housing and gears assumed)
facts.function: speed-changing gear drive for a fertilizer spreader

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8483 names gear boxes and speed changers

Section XVI note 2(a): parts that are themselves goods of a chapter 84 heading (8483 is not among the excluded headings only for 8409,8431,8448,8466,8473 etc.) go to their own heading, so the gearbox is not classified as a part of 8432
GRI 6: 8483.40.50 other gear boxes; 8483.40.50.10 fixed ratio speed changers (assumed)

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of spreaders; the gearbox is a good of heading 8483, which note 2(a) keeps in its own heading
other speed changers applies to variable-ratio types; ratio not stated

missing_facts: whether gearbox is fixed ratio or variable ratio
whether it is for a wind turbine (no)
classification.rationale: A gearbox assembly is a good described by heading 8483 (gear boxes). Section XVI note 2(a) sends it to 8483 rather than to parts of 8432. N355530 (in force) classed a fixed-ratio gearbox in 8483.40.5010; the ratio of this gearbox is assumed fixed. Heading 8432 parts remains arguable.
